discovery.title: Five baby orangutans found in India raise questions about wildlife trafficking
discovery.summary: Villagers in India found five baby orangutans in a forest in September. Their discovery has brought fresh attention to the illegal wildlife trade and to questions about how endangered animals are moved across borders.
discovery.why_it_matters: A single discovery can expose how wildlife trafficking connects distant places—and put pressure on authorities to trace animals’ origins.
